**About us \-**

Your Journey to Radiant, Confident Skin Starts Here

Derma Solutions is a skin, hair and aesthetic clinic in Marathahalli, Whitefield, Bangalore. We combine expert dermatology with advanced cosmetic and surgical treatments, giving you the right care for every concern.

Led by Dr Sandeep Mahapatra (MBBS, MD Dermatology), our team focuses on accurate diagnosis, personalised treatment plans and transparent guidance, with no pressure or guesswork.

FEATURE POINTS

* Doctor-led diagnosis & personalised plans  
* FDA-approved lasers & advanced technology  
* Skin, hair & cosmetic care under one roof  
* Open 7 days | 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM

Speak to a specialist: \+91 97412 23217

**Why choose us \-** 

**![][image8]**  
**![][image9]**  
**Heading:**  Why Patients Across Bangalore Choose Derma Solutions

**Experience badge:**  20+ Years of Expertise

* **Tailored Treatment Plans.** Every skin is unique. We build personalized plans based on an in-depth diagnosis, not a fixed menu.

* **Comprehensive Care Under One Roof.** From common skin conditions to advanced cosmetic and surgical procedures, you are treated by the right specialist without being sent elsewhere.

* **Patient-Centered Approach.** Your comfort, safety and results come first, with clear communication at every step.

* **Modern Medical Technology.** We use the latest FDA-approved lasers and cosmetic technology, including Q-switched ND:YAG and advanced systems for safe, effective outcomes.
